correctness.rationale: A total dominating set forces its perpendicular hyperplanes to cover \(\mathbb F_q^n\), and at most \(q\) such hyperplanes cannot do so. Explicit two-plane constructions attain \(q+1\) for total domination in both characteristics, attain \(q+1\) paired domination for odd \(q\), and attain the parity lower bound \(q+2\) for even \(q\).
